interactionHistory.label: Open Bring Your Own CV Modal

uxObservations.userGoal: Get pre-engineered prompts to audit my CV in ChatGPT or Claude without exposing personal API keys
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Modal with ready-to-copy prompts tailored with my exact CV data, plus direct launch links to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Opened AI prompt generator and inspected audit prompt.
uxObservations.recommendation: Pre-computed prompts with full CV context save immense time over manual copying.

uxObservations.userGoal: Translate CV to English tailored for the US Tech market
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Target language selector with US Tech localization rules and formatted prompt.
uxObservations.recommendation: Cultural adaptation instructions (CEFR levels, US tech roles) guide the LLM accurately.

uxObservations.userGoal: Import an existing resume from an external PDF or JSON document
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Two-step bidirectional bridge: (1) Copy prompt to extract JSON from old CV, (2) Paste JSON back to render immediately.
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: Requires user to understand what JSON is when pasting back the response.
uxObservations.recommendation: Add a 1-click "Pegar Respuesta" helper with format validation that gives human-friendly error messages if the paste is invalid.

uxObservations.userGoal: Get real-time feedback on ATS rules, tech casing, and action verbs
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Contextual tooltip styled as Obsidian callout (Danger red, Warning orange, Info blue).
uxObservations.actionTaken: Triggered section tips via lightbulb button.
uxObservations.recommendation: Section-level tips button directly activates the pre-computed ATS suggestion engine.

uxObservations.userGoal: Customize the visual style of section bullets and title dots
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Three horizontal dots icon (MoreHorizontal) in the section header action buttons on hover.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Hovered over the section and clicked the three dots button.
uxObservations.frictionAnalysis: The three dots icon is ambiguous: users might expect it to be a general menu (Copy, Move, Settings) rather than specifically a bullet/circle style configurator.
uxObservations.recommendation: Change the icon to a bullet-list or palette icon, or provide a tooltip: "Personalizar viñetas".

uxObservations.userGoal: Add another bullet accomplishment to my current job
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Inline button "+ Agregar nueva viñeta" below current job bullets.
uxObservations.recommendation: The explicit text "+ Agregar nueva viñeta" is immediately clear to naive users.

uxObservations.userGoal: Delete an accidental or obsolete bullet point
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Minus circle button on the right edge of the bullet row.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked minus button to delete bullet.
uxObservations.recommendation: Direct row deletion is snappy and responsive.

uxObservations.userGoal: Open version history and backup hub
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Fullscreen modal showing version management cards, save bar, and JSON controls.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Clicked versions icon in the left toolbar.
uxObservations.recommendation: Full modal presentation with cards and timestamps is very confidence-inspiring.

uxObservations.userGoal: Create a named backup of the CV
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: New card appeared in version list with timestamp and name.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Typed version name and clicked "Guardar Versión".
uxObservations.recommendation: Instant visual card feedback confirms the backup succeeded.

uxObservations.userGoal: Prevent accidental erasure of the resume
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Confirmation modal warning that current changes will be replaced with a blank template.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Observed warning modal and clicked Cancel.
uxObservations.recommendation: Strong safety barrier protects user from catastrophic accidental deletion.

uxObservations.userGoal: Understand how many physical pages my resume currently spans
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: 1 physical paper-like sheet(s) with clear drop shadows and margins.
uxObservations.recommendation: Physical discrete sheets (Invariant 15) eliminate the guesswork of where page breaks fall.

uxObservations.feature: Page Separation Margin in Editor View
uxObservations.userGoal: Clearly differentiate page 1 from page 2 while editing
uxObservations.whatUserSaw: Inter-page spacing with visible margin (32px) separating sheets.
uxObservations.actionTaken: Scrolled down to view boundary between pages.
uxObservations.recommendation: Visual separation between discrete A4 sheets gives instant WYSIWYG feedback.
